title: Implement access token context encoding framework

comments.text: Syntax issue: the rawTokenId null check calls Objects.requireNonNull on grantType instead of rawTokenId. Suggested change is to validate rawTokenId with the same "Null rawTokenId not allowed" message.
Style issue: catching generic RuntimeException is too broad. The implementation throws IllegalArgumentException, so the test should catch that type instead.
Typo in the assertion message: "Not expected to success" should read "Not expected to succeed" (suggested fix also reworded to "due to incorrect grant type").
Style issue: the grantsByShortcuts and grantsToShortcuts map fields should be private to follow encapsulation. Suggested change adds the private modifier to both.
Critical logic error: the condition comparing the grant shortcut (substring 3 to 5) to expectedGrantShortcut returns false when they match. It should negate the check so it returns false on mismatch.
Logic issue: the TokenContextEncoderProvider is fetched via session.getProvider and used without a null check, which could cause a NullPointerException if the provider is not registered.
Style issue: the Javadoc says grant shortcuts are usually 3 letters, but the implementations use 2-letter shortcuts such as "ac", "cc", and "rt". Suggests updating the doc to say 2 to 3 letters.
